responsibility: This file implements GCC’s simple normalized approximate real-number type sreal, a lightweight finite real representation used internally where infinities and NaNs are unnecessary. It provides arithmetic, comparison-supporting normalization, conversion to integer and debug double form, shifting and rounding behavior, and LTO/data-streamer serialization hooks, along with checking-build selftests. Its responsibility is to supply a compact, overflow-bounded real-valued quantity for analyses such as callgraph or heuristic modeling rather than full target floating-point semantics.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file provides the out-of-line behavior for the sreal class from gcc/sreal.h, including arithmetic method bodies, integer/double conversion, debug dumping, LTO streaming, and checking-only selftests.
